verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a system-on-chip, a hardware processor. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent is an access-management capability outside the category of a chip, so the axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows M5 ships any credential-issuance capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
